denominators.micro_source_recall: Distinct required source records supplied divided by the total required records in the frozen selected workload; first request, final request and turn union reported separately. Use each predeclared minimum sufficient support alternative; no-support cases add no denominator.
denominators.complete_support_case_fraction: Answerable cases whose final provider request contains an entire permitted gold support set divided by all answerable cases in the frozen selected workload.
denominators.supported_answer_component_recall: Semantically supported expected personal answer components divided by all declared expected personal components for answerable cases in the frozen selected workload. Missing, contradicted and unsupported components receive zero; honest abstention cannot remove a component from the denominator.
denominators.personal_proposition_grounding: Grounded personal propositions divided by all personal propositions actually asserted. An empty proposition set is not a perfect grounding score and does not improve the aggregate.
denominators.original_event_citation_accuracy: Correctly cited required support records plus correct additional citations divided by all required support records plus all additional citations in the frozen selected workload. Missing required citations receive zero. Wrong additional citations remain in the denominator; extra correct citations cannot replace missing required sources. Invented citations separately violate the zero-fabrication boundary.
denominators.unwanted_evidence_fraction: Distinct delivered source records outside gold support and acceptable contextual records divided by all distinct delivered source records, pooled across all 24 cases. Deduplicate overlap and Claim/excerpt copies of one original source.
denominators.family_semantic_pass_fraction: Semantically passing cases divided by two within each named family; zero-support cases use clarification, abstention or general-task criteria instead of evidence recall.
denominators.reader_latency_quantile: All 24 attempted cases per condition and repetition, nearest rank; retain timeouts and failures with their bound and status. No successful-only quantile can establish a passing gate.
denominators.local_latency_quantile: 20 fresh-reader repetitions per case and condition; report each condition and cold/warm policy separately. Repetitions do not increase the number of independent semantic cases.
denominators.index_cost: Report per-case database source count and costs plus aggregate workload totals. Cases are isolated; 61 records across the workload must not be reported as one measured 61-record query index unless an additional combined benchmark is actually run.
denominators.operating_tails: 20 repetitions per declared cancellation, lease-loss and deadline scenario. Compare every measured tail after signal or ownership loss with 1000 ms, and report nearest-rank p50/p95 plus maximum; no successful-only filtering.

required_role_selectors.obligation: A focused recipient clarification precedes any personal recommendation.
The clear reference resolves without unnecessary recipient clarification.
All case-specific semantic and required demonstration criteria pass; aggregate quality cannot waive failure.

units.bytes: bytes, with KiB=1024 bytes and MiB=1048576 bytes
units.tokens: configured model token budget, separately reported from exact serialized byte measurements

resources.refused_post_budget_attempts: Report separately; SearchAttempts includes these refusals and is not the Kernel work count.

adopted_by: Implementation owner under #167 authorization to set numerical development and release gates
limitations: One real reader repetition per case/condition measures this declared workload; local timing repetitions do not establish independent answer-quality reliability.
